name: Lampac NextGen
description: Lampac NextGen is a self-hosted ASP.NET Core backend for Lampa. It aggregates media-provider links, exposes Lampa-compatible plugins and APIs, and optionally provides synchronization, DLNA, torrent, transcoding and related media services.

notes.text: Lampac listens on port 9118. The Lampa online plugin is available at http://<IP>:9118/online.js.
A random root password for Lampac administrative endpoints is generated during installation and stored in /opt/lampac/passwd. Read it with 'cat /opt/lampac/passwd'.

The starter configuration enables the Lampa online plugin, TorrServer and TimeCode. Resource-heavy optional modules such as Transcoding and DLNA remain disabled; configure additional modules in /opt/lampac/init.conf.
Both amd64 and arm64 are supported for the core service. The optional GStreamer HDR-to-SDR native tone-mapping plugin is currently provided only for Linux x64.
